name: GART
aliases: GART — A method that extends the human to more articulated models (e.g., animals) based on the 3DGS representation.
definition: A method that extends the human to more articulated models (e.g., animals) based on the 3DGS representation.
summary: GART is a 3D Gaussian Splatting method that animates articulated non-human models like animals by extending human avatar deformation principles to broader skeletons.
